recent_excerpts: MacSync's new build drops AppleScript droppers for Objective-C and Swift binaries, delivers payloads via iCloud calendar events, and adds a backdoor module.
Kaspersky found hundreds of MovieReaper victims across 10+ countries after attackers poisoned itorrents.org, serving fake "The Odyssey" torrents that drop a Solana-C2 trojan.
Kaspersky found ValleyRAT delivered via fake adware installer that disables Defender and sideloads libcef.dll. Targets Chinese-speaking users.
